title: Cosmic Dragon Wizard
description: A massive purple dragon with a glowing cosmic spiral body coils through a starry vortex in the sky. In the foreground, a hooded wizard holds a glowing blue staff beside a giant green mushroom, while turbulent waves with jellyfish and bubbles crash below and four silhouetted figures stand on a distant shore.
prompt: A majestic purple cosmic dragon with a swirling galaxy body and glowing stars coils through a swirling purple vortex in a stormy night sky, giant iridescent dragonflies and glowing bubbles float around, a hooded wizard in purple robe holds a glowing blue staff next to a giant dripping green mushroom with dragonflies on top, turbulent teal and purple waves with jellyfish and sea creatures in the foreground, four silhouetted figures on a distant shore, dramatic fantasy scene
